message.content:
This document describes **Project Maya**, a local LLM inference stack for running large MoE models on consumer/prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Models & Quantization**
- Maya provides its own quantized versions of **GLM-5.3-Flash** (XS/S/M/L tiers by expert bit-width), plus **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017** (748B params, MIT) and **MiniMax-M3.1-Flash** (428B, 23B active) on separate engines (`maya-ds4`, `maya-mm3`).
- Quants
